name: The Lantern Yard
strapline: Slow mornings, long lunches and drinks that run into the evening.
shortWelcome: An easy-going neighbourhood café and bar built for dropping in and staying longer than planned.
aboutLead: The Lantern Yard shifts naturally from coffee and brunch into dinner plates and evening drinks.
aboutBody: The room is informal, the menu is compact and the idea is simple: good things served without ceremony. Come in for a quick coffee, meet friends for lunch, or settle in after work.
seoDescription: A fictional café and bar used to test the HospoLP second-client workflow.
footerNote: Mock business used for HospoLP testing.
